t: 法国的亨利四世颁布"南特教令",允许胡盖诺特人享有宗教自由.
te: Henry IV of France issues the Edict of Nantes, allowing freedom of religion to the Huguenots.
dz: 法国的亨利四世颁布"南特教令",允许胡盖诺特人享有宗教自由.
de: Henry IV of France issues the Edict of Nantes, allowing freedom of religion to the Huguenots.

t: 胡安·德·奥尼亚特开始征服新墨西哥州圣菲.
te: Juan de Oñate begins the conquest of Santa Fe de Nuevo México.
dz: 胡安·德·奥尼亚特开始征服新墨西哥州圣菲.
de: Juan de Oñate begins the conquest of Santa Fe de Nuevo México.

t: 西班牙控制的波多黎各圣胡安的Castillo San Felipe del Morro被围困了…
te: The Spanish-held Castillo San Felipe del Morro in San Juan, Puerto Rico having been besieged for fifteen days, surrende…
dz: 西班牙控制的波多黎各圣胡安的Castillo San Felipe del Morro被围困了15天,向由Cumberland Earl George Clifford爵士领导的英国部队投降.
de: The Spanish-held Castillo San Felipe del Morro in San Juan, Puerto Rico having been besieged for fifteen days, surrenders to an English force under Sir George Clifford, Earl of Cumberland.

t: 威廉·莎士比亚的戏剧《威尼斯商人》已列入文具登记册。根据伊丽莎白女王的法令，文具登记册许可印刷…
te: William Shakespeare's play, The Merchant of Venice, is entered on the Stationers' Register. By decree of Queen Elizabet…
dz: 威廉·莎士比亚的戏剧《威尼斯商人》已列入文具登记册。根据伊丽莎白女王的法令，文具登记册许可印刷作品，使皇室能够严格控制所有出版材料。
de: William Shakespeare's play, The Merchant of Venice, is entered on the Stationers' Register. By decree of Queen Elizabeth, the Stationers' Register licensed printed works, giving the Crown tight control over all published material.

t: 黄福特之战:休·奥尼尔所领导的爱尔兰部队,泰隆伯爵所部击败了亨利·巴格纳尔所部下的一支英格兰远…
te: Battle of the Yellow Ford: Irish forces under Hugh O'Neill, Earl of Tyrone, defeat an English expeditionary force under…
dz: 九年战争:黄福特之战:休·奥尼尔所领导的爱尔兰部队,泰隆伯爵所部击败了亨利·巴格纳尔所部下的一支英格兰远征军.
de: Nine Years' War: Battle of the Yellow Ford: Irish forces under Hugh O'Neill, Earl of Tyrone, defeat an English expeditionary force under Henry Bagenal.

t: 鹭梁海战：七年战争的最后一战，在中朝联军与日本海军之间展开，最终联军取得决定性胜利。
te: Battle of Noryang: The final battle of the Seven-Year War is fought between the China and the Korean allied forces and …
dz: 七年战争：鹭梁海战：七年战争的最后一战，在中朝联军与日本海军之间展开，最终联军取得决定性胜利。
de: Seven-Year War: Battle of Noryang: The final battle of the Seven-Year War is fought between the China and the Korean allied forces and Japanese navies, resulting in a decisive allied forces victory.

t: 由卡西克·佩伦塔鲁领导的造反的马普切人,使西班牙军队在智利南部大败.
te: The revolting Mapuche, led by cacique Pelentaru, inflict a major defeat on Spanish troops in southern Chile.
dz: 库拉拉巴战役:由卡西克·佩伦塔鲁领导的造反的马普切人,使西班牙军队在智利南部大败.
de: Battle of Curalaba: The revolting Mapuche, led by cacique Pelentaru, inflict a major defeat on Spanish troops in southern Chile.

t: 智利总督马丁·加西亚·切斯·德·洛约拉被佩兰塔鲁领导的马普切斯所杀.
te: Governor of Chile Martín García Óñez de Loyola is killed in the Battle of Curalaba by Mapuches led by Pelantaru.
dz: 阿劳克战争:智利总督马丁·加西亚·切斯·德·洛约拉被佩兰塔鲁领导的马普切斯所杀.
de: Arauco War: Governor of Chile Martín García Óñez de Loyola is killed in the Battle of Curalaba by Mapuches led by Pelantaru.
